name: Brush teeth for two minutes
short_description: Brush teeth for two minutes once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can brush teeth for two minutes in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Brush teeth for two minutes means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Brush teeth for two minutes in a fresh real-life scenario.
